# Comfy Bria- Guided Background Removal

Remove the background from an image with Bria while keeping whatever a text prompt describes, so one subject can be cut out of a busy scene instead of losing everything that is not background. The original pixels come back at full resolution with a new alpha channel. Ideal for product cutouts, portrait isolation and compositing prep. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bria_guided_remove_background.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
